sections.text_helper: Section 30.5.7 "AHB and SDMMC_CK clock relation" in chapter 30 (Secure digital input/output MultiMediaCard interface (SDMMC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1404.
sections.section_content:
The AHB must at least have between 1.72x and 3x more bandwidth than the SDMMC bus
bandwidth i.e. for SDR50 4-bit mode (50Mbyte/s) the minimum sdmmc_hclk frequency is
21.43MHz (85.72Mbyte/s).
[Table 225. AHB and SDMMC_CK clock frequency relation]
Warning: When minimum HCLK frequency is not respected, overrun or
underrun errors may occur even when hardware flow control
is enabled.
